subject: Polyvinyl chloride
hook: POLYVINYL CHLORIDE IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK
angle: While raw PVC is naturally a brittle solid, it is unique among common plastics in absorbing massive amounts of additives—allowing flexible vinyl products to consist of over 85% plasticizer by mass to become a soft gel.
angle_support: Among the common plastics, PVC is unique in its acceptance of large amounts of plasticizer, yielding physical properties that range continuously from a rigid solid to a soft gel, and almost 90% of all plasticizer production is used in making flexible PVC.
Flexible PVC can consist of over 85% plasticizer by mass, but unplasticized PVC (UPVC) should not contain any.
title: Why Your Flexible Vinyl Is Mostly Liquid
description: While most people associate PVC with hard pipes and construction materials, flexible vinyl products are actually composed primarily of plasticizing additives rather than the polymer itself.
narration: POLYVINYL CHLORIDE IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK You picture rigid white pipes or stiff plastic bottles. It was closer to a soft, malleable gel. Raw vinyl is naturally a brittle, unusable solid on its own. PVC is unique among plastics for its massive additive absorption. To achieve flexibility, manufacturers blend in plasticizers. In these soft applications, the final product can consist of over eighty-five percent plasticizer by total mass alone. The plastic is merely a structural scaffold for the liquid additives.
